technology_name: Hydrophobic Membrane Incorporating Iron Hydroxide for Water Distillation
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard water distillation membranes lack high-temperature structural stability and are easily fouled by toxic organic pollutants, disrupting clean water flux.
description: The engineering of a high-porosity mixed-matrix hydrophobic membrane incorporating iron oxyhydroxide nanoparticles to ensure high thermal stability, structural chemical inertia, and a water contact angle exceeding 120 degrees.
applications: Desalination plants, industrial toxic aqueous concentration loops, chemical wastewater remediation systems, and pure water reclamation.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
